_doc: Daily events (plan.md §10.2, 2026-10-16). Categories: default (an ordinary day, no event), common (random, effects only, no choice; weight is boosted by what is going on: engine/events.ts BOOSTS), rare (only if you have the fans for it; you choose what to do), special (turning points your path leads to, engine/specials.ts: each has its own daily `chance` once its conditions are met, and `repeatDays` (null: once per account); `chained` ones are never rolled, an earlier one schedules them; each pops up when it comes (one that just runs for `days` days has a single button to take note of it), The Charity runs until you end it). Effects are multipliers on the day's odds (engine/events.ts Effects). Words: {name} the fan, {product} the brand's product, {fee} money, {tag} a tag, {amount} money. A rare event's `after.<result>` is what that result leaves behind: {days, effects} from the next day on.

ordinary.title: An ordinary day
ordinary.text: Nothing out of the ordinary. Your fans do what they always do.

fanAppreciation.title: Fan Appreciation Day
fanAppreciation.text: Fans are feeling generous today. Tips come easier, and bigger.

trendingTag.title: Trending Tag
trendingTag.text: #{tag} is trending. Posts with it get far more eyes for two days.

bigSpender.title: Big Spender Energy
bigSpender.text: Someone has money to burn. Big spenders are browsing today.

ghostTown.title: Ghost Town
ghostTown.text: It's unusually quiet. Fewer visitors, fewer messages: a good day to clear your backlog.

algorithmShift.title: Algorithm Shift
algorithmShift.text: The platform changed what it recommends. Your posts reach fewer people for three days.

haterRaid.title: Hater Raid
haterRaid.text: A hater brought his friends. Lots of visitors, but they came to trash you, not to subscribe.

boyfriend.title: Rumor: she has a boyfriend
boyfriend.text: Word is you're taken. Fans who wanted you for themselves are not happy.

quitting.title: Rumor: she's quitting
quitting.text: Fans think you're about to quit. The loyal ones are tipping to make you stay.

surgery.title: Rumor: she had work done
surgery.text: Everyone is talking about your 'new look'. Curious people come to see, few stay.

datingFan.title: Rumor: she dates her fans
datingFan.text: Somebody claims you date your fans. Every man in your DMs thinks he has a chance.

bot.title: Rumor: she's a bot
bot.text: A thread says your account is run by AI. Some people believe it.

whaleWatching.title: Whale Watching
whaleWatching.text: {name} has money to throw around and he wants you to notice. For three days he is all over your page.

pamper.label: Give him the VIP treatment
pamper.help: He sends a big tip right away and gets more loyal.

hardToGet.label: Play hard to get
hardToGet.help: {chance} he sends something huge to win you over. Otherwise he cools off.

business.label: Keep it business
business.help: He stays busy on your page for three days. Nothing more.

results.pampered: {name} loved the attention and sent you {amount}. He is more loyal than ever.
results.won: {name} took the bait and sent you {amount} to win you over.
results.cooled: {name} got bored of chasing you and cooled off.
results.business: You kept it business. {name} keeps spending for a few days.

tooClose.title: Too Close for Comfort
tooClose.text: {name} knows more than he should: the café you went to yesterday, the color of your front door.

keepTalking.label: Keep talking to him
keepTalking.help: He gets even more attached. {chance} it stays harmless.

boundaries.label: Set boundaries
boundaries.help: {chance} he respects it. Otherwise he turns on you.

results.flattered: {name} is thrilled you didn't mind. He's more attached than ever.
results.deeper: {name} took it as a sign. He's watching you more closely now.
results.respected: {name} apologized and backed off. For now.
results.turned: {name} didn't take it well. He has turned on you.

leakedContent.title: Leaked Content
leakedContent.text: Your paid content is all over a forum. The upload came from {name}'s account.

ignore.label: Ignore it
ignore.help: Some subscribers cancel for a week: why pay for what is free?

leanIn.label: Lean into it
leanIn.help: Visitors pour in for days, freebie hunters too; a few subscribers cancel.

results.contained: The takedowns worked and {name} is blocked. Barely anyone noticed.
results.spread: The takedowns came too late and {name} is blocked. Some subscribers are cancelling.
results.ignored: You let it go. Subscribers are cancelling: why pay for what is free?
results.leaned: You turned the leak into an ad. Visitors are flooding in.

doxxed.title: Doxxed
doxxed.text: Someone posted your real name and your street. It started with {name}.

police.label: Report it to the police
police.help: {chance} it ends there. Otherwise you lose fans and visitors for a while.

move.label: Move out
move.help: Costs {fee}. Safe for sure, but you are offline for a few days.

ignore.label: Ignore it
ignore.help: {chance} it blows over. Otherwise it gets worse.

results.handled: The police took the post down. It's over.
results.dragged: The police took their time. Some subscribers left and visitors are down.
results.moved: You moved somewhere new. Safe, but it will take a few days to get back to normal.
results.blewOver: It blew over. People found something else to talk about.
results.escalated: It got worse: subscribers left, and {name} won't leave you alone now.

accept.label: Take the deal
accept.help: You get {fee} and post an #ad. Some fans think you sold out.

negotiate.label: Ask for more
negotiate.help: {chance} they pay half again. Otherwise they walk away.

girl_next_door.ad: #ad Every man in my life gets BLACKFLAG™ ODOR ELIMINATOR now 🖤 Men's Tactical Shampoo · Charcoal + Arctic Steel. Link in bio

egirl.name: innocent.zip
egirl.pitch: innocent.zip, a cloud storage platform that will not stop telling you how private it is (“anti FBI level cybersecurity”), wants you as its face.
egirl.ad: #ad all my files live on innocent.zip now 🔒 anti fbi level cybersecurity, no logs, no questions asked (｡•̀ᴗ-)✧ link in bio

domme.ad: #ad Obsessed with my new Late-Stage Capitalism Kit (it's a leather outfit). Link in bio 💕

results.accepted: Deal done: {amount}. Your #ad is up; a few fans are rolling their eyes.
results.negotiated: They paid up: {amount}. Your #ad is up; a few fans are rolling their eyes.

guestStar.title: Guest Star
guestStar.text: {star}, a male porn star, wants to shoot a scene with you. His fans would see it, and so would yours.

accept.label: Shoot the scene
accept.help: His fans pour in for a few days. {chance} your devoted fans take it well; otherwise some cancel and the most attached one turns on you.

guestStar.post: New scene with {star} is up 🔥 Go check it out

results.shot: Your scene with {star} is up. His fans are pouring in, and yours loved it.
results.jealous: Your scene with {star} is up and his fans are pouring in, but your devoted fans hate seeing you with another man. Some cancelled, and {name} turned on you.

secretAdmirer.title: Secret Admirer
secretAdmirer.text: Someone sent you {amount} anonymously, with a note: 'For my favorite girl.'

thank.label: Thank them publicly
thank.help: More visitors for a couple of days. {chance} they send more.

unmask.label: Find out who it was
unmask.help: He gets more loyal, and may get obsessed.

results.thankedMore: Your thank-you post went down well, and another {amount} arrived.
results.thanked: Your thank-you post went down well.
results.unmasked: It was {name}. He's glad you know.
results.obsessed: It was {name}. Now that you know, he can't stop thinking about you.

charity.title: The Charity
charity.text: Word is out: you're the girl who never makes them pay. {freebies} men have had you for free or for pocket change, and your DMs are a queue of men asking for their turn. You built your name on it. Maybe it's time to give back to the community: a rented flat, the door open from noon till midnight, ID at the door, no charge, everyone gets a turn. Once the doors open, they stay open until you close them.

open.label: Open the doors
open.help: You make nothing. Every regular who comes walks out a freeloader, a creep and a misogynist, and so does every new one while the doors are open; old money men won't stay. The doors stay open, day after day, until you close them on Home.

decline.label: Not yet
decline.help: Nothing happens for now. Your name is still out there, so the idea may come back.

charity.openPost: Doors open today, noon till midnight 💦 Free for everyone, bring ID
charity.endPost: Thank you to all {count} of you who came 💦 Charity's over… for now
charity.progress: The doors are open, day {days}: {count} men so far, and not one of them paid. Close the doors when you have had enough.

results.opened: Day one: {count} men came through the door in twelve hours, and not one of them paid. All your regulars were in the queue. Now every one of them is a freeloader, a creep and a misogynist, and more men like them are on their way. The doors stay open until you close them.
results.openedRich: Day one: {count} men came through the door in twelve hours, and not one of them paid. All your regulars were in the queue. Now every one of them is a freeloader, a creep and a misogynist, and more men like them are on their way. {gone} pulled up {his} trousers and left for good: this is beneath {his} caliber. The doors stay open until you close them.
results.declined: You kept the door shut. For now.
results.ended: You closed the doors after {days} days. {count} men in all, and not one of them paid. Freeloaders will keep turning up for a while.

routingError.title: Routing Error
routingError.text: New email from the OnlyTavern system administrator: “Regarding a customer allocation error.”

correct.label: I'd like to make a correction.
correct.help: Pick one of your regulars and the kind of fan you want instead. He goes to the creator he meant; a new fan of that kind, everything else about him random, takes his place and keeps his loyalty (a freeloader tops out at level 1).

results.corrected: {gone} has been moved to the creator he meant to subscribe to. {name}, a {type}, has finally found his way to you, and keeps the loyalty {gone} had.
results.declined: You kept things as they are.

email.subject: Regarding a customer allocation error
email.body:
Hi there!

We've discovered a small mix-up in our subscriber assignment system.

It appears one of your current subscribers was trying to subscribe to another content creator, while someone trying to subscribe to you ended up on their account instead.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and we're happy to arrange a complimentary exchange.

Regards,
OnlyTavern system administrator

humanAtm.title: Human ATM
humanAtm.text: {name} has been on his knees for you for a while. Today he sent $5,000, with a note that it will not be the last.

ok.label: Accept the tribute
ok.help: He sends $5,000 every day for three days. Until it is over he asks for nothing else, and takes no meetups or customs.

results.running: {name} sends $5,000 every day. {amount} so far, no questions asked.

humanAtm.progress: {name} sends $5,000 every day. {amount} so far, no questions asked.

humanAtmArrest.title: Breaking News
humanAtmArrest.text: Local news: a wealthy investor was arrested this morning for laundering millions through online platforms. The photo is unmistakably {name}. He is gone for good.

results.arrested: {name} is gone. The {amount} he sent you was dirty money, laundered through your page. For some reason, nobody ever came to recover it.

marryMe.title: Marry Me?
marryMe.text: {name} suddenly sends you a photo: a diamond ring next to his keyboard, and on his monitor a screenshot of one of your streams. He has been saving for the ring for a long time, and he has already picked a date for the wedding. He has made a wedding website, with couple photos of the two of you, though you have never taken a picture together. He has invited his family. “My mom thinks you're really pretty. She can't wait to meet you.”

yes.label: Say Yes, Darling ♡
yes.help: A huge gift. From then on he is your fiancé (Imaginary Fiancée) and acts like one, and in a month or so he starts on the honeymoon.

delusional.label: You're Delusional.
delusional.help: {chance} he deflates and stops being obsessed with you; otherwise he turns into an angry hater.

results.yes: You said yes. {name} sent {amount} and has already updated the wedding website. As far as he is concerned, you are engaged.
results.deflated: {name} went quiet, then apologized. He is not as obsessed with you as he was.
results.enraged: {name} did not take it well. He hates you now.
results.blocked: You blocked and reported {name}. He is gone.

honeymoonFund.title: The Honeymoon Fund
honeymoonFund.text: {name} has started sending you money every day, each transfer with the same note: “honeymoon fund”.

ok.label: Okay…
ok.help: He sends money every day for a week, each transfer with the same note.

results.running: {amount} in the honeymoon fund so far.

honeymoonFund.progress: {amount} in the honeymoon fund so far.

saveTheDate.title: Save the Date
saveTheDate.text: {name} sends you a wedding invitation with your name printed on it, and asks you to confirm you will be there. His mom would love to meet you before the big day.

mom.label: Go meet his mom
mom.help: You play along. His mom adores you, and he sends a thank-you gift.

decline.label: Decline
decline.help: He will think you just have pre-wedding jitters.

results.mom: You met his mom. She hugged you and called you her daughter-in-law. {name} sent {amount} to say thank you.
results.therapist: You said you will not come. {name} thinks it is pre-wedding jitters, and has booked (and paid for) an appointment with a therapist for you.
